title: 3.2 Single Rotations (LL / RR)
objective: Repair LL and RR imbalances by clicking the unbalanced pivot node (|BF| = 2) on each puzzle!
controls: Click the imbalanced pivot node to perform single rotation
start_status: Puzzle 1/2 (LL): Click the unbalanced pivot node to rotate right!
hints: The pivot is the topmost node whose |BF| is 2. A left-heavy chain needs a right rotation.
Now the chain leans right: the topmost node has |BF| 2 and needs a left rotation.
